basics.name: Mingxuan Wang
basics.label: B.S. Computer Science and Engineering
basics.summary: A CS undergraduate at CUHK-Shenzhen (SDS), researching spoken language processing and generative AI for (multilingual) speech & audio.

location.address: Longxiang Ave. No. 2001, The Chinese University of Hong Kong Shenzhen

work.name: CUHK-Shenzhen, Spoken Language Communications (SLC) Lab
work.summary: Independent research under Prof. Satoshi Nakamura on a fully discrete machine speech chain (TokenChain).
highlights: Coupled semantic-token ASR with a two-stage TTS (AR text-to-semantic; NAR semantic-to-acoustic)
Enabled end-to-end feedback via straight-through argmax/Gumbel-Softmax with dynamic weight averaging
Achieved faster convergence and lower equal-epoch error in experiments; manuscript submitted to ICASSP 2026

work.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
work.summary: Investigated semantics/syntax separation in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models under Prof. Georg Groh.
highlights: Designed, implemented and evaluated MoE routing and probing pipelines
Trained novel MoE models, defined and compared with baselines
Conducted ablations for router design and model explainability

work.name: CUHK-Shenzhen, OpenMMLab
work.summary: Contributed to Amphion and SingVisio projects.
highlights: Implemented features for Amphion and SingVisio
Optimized and debugged code to accelerate critical milestones
Created a celebrity-speech dataset enabling future speech-generation research

work.name: The Hong Kong Research Institute of Textiles and Apparel (HKRITA)
work.summary: Supported enterprise systems and cloud strategy initiatives.
highlights: Managed the ERP system across 20+ projects
Led feasibility study for a cloud-based service adoption
Collaborated with Microsoft and partners on migration planning, cloud architectures, and IT strategy

publications.name: TokenChain: Fully Discrete Machine Speech Chain
publications.summary: Couples semantic-token ASR with a two-stage TTS and uses straight-through estimators for end-to-end feedback; submitted to ICASSP 2026.

publications.name: SingVisio: Visual Analytics of Diffusion Model for Singing Voice Conversion
publications.summary: Defined objective criteria of audio data to visualize diffusion training dynamics; designed and analyzed 20+ expert surveys; co-authored paper and produced a demo video.

publications.name: Amphion: An Open-Source Audio, Music and Speech Generation Toolkit
publications.summary: Contributed to evaluation pipeline for text-to-speech; improved benchmarking efficiency; enhanced large-dataset TTS with multi-speaker functionality.
